entities.name: Hakim Loreweaver
entities.description: Historian and wizard from Suq'Ata on Dominaria, a charming braggart called Loreweaver for his gift for telling stories.

entities.name: Suq'Ata
entities.description: Country on Dominaria that Hakim represented.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: Planeswalker, once Hakim's apprentice, who sent Hakim a dream.

entities.name: Mangara
entities.description: Organizer of peace talks, held in an Amber Prison.

entities.name: Zhalfir
entities.description: Nation party to the peace talks, now phased-in.

entities.name: Femeref
entities.description: Nation party to the peace talks.

entities.name: Asmira
entities.description: Prophet who explained destiny drove them to rescue Mangara.

entities.name: Rashida Scalebane
entities.description: Formed an elite guard for the rescue mission.

entities.name: Sidar Jabari
entities.description: Created a distraction for the rescue mission with Hakim.

entities.name: Ki'pamu
entities.description: Zhalfirin capital near which they met.

entities.name: Amber Prison
entities.description: Prison in which Mangara was held.

entities.name: Mwonvuli Jungle
entities.description: Jungle containing the palace where Mangara was held.

events.summary: Hakim is entrusted to represent Suq'Ata in the peace talks Mangara organized.
events.quote: Hakim was entrusted by the rulers of Suq'Ata to represent his country

events.summary: Hakim meets Asmira, Rashida and Jabari near Ki'pamu; Asmira explains they must rescue Mangara.
events.quote: destiny was driving them to rescue Mangara

events.summary: Hakim tells a tale rooted in a dream from Teferi that makes Kaervek's besieging armies vanish while the civilians escape Tefemburu.
events.quote: The tale wove a spell that caused the dark armies besieging the city to vanish completely at dusk

relations.quote: Hakim met with Asmira the Prophet
When Kaervek 's legions besieged the city of Tefemburu
